messages.text: I never received my order if milkweed seeds. Can I still get them? If not, please refund me.

messages.subject: Re: Where is my order?
messages.text:
Hello Sharon,
 

 We reassure you that your order was indeed sent on March 16 by regular mail, with a stamp. We informed you of this by email. It should have arrived no later than 12 business days later. It is not normal that you still have not received anything.
 We will contact the carrier, but so as not to keep you waiting any longer, we will proceed with a new shipment of your order. Please be assured that we will let you know as soon as your order has been shipped.
 

 We also saw that you left us a review. That is absolutely not the experience we want to offer our customers, and we apologize for this situation, which was beyond our control.
 

 If you have any other questions, we remain at your disposal.
 

 Warmly,
 __
 Hari 
 

 Lasclay
